screen.interpretation: Mode2 caller interval is the request metric. Newly spawned LLM threads start their clocks at zero, so raw worker marker spans are NOT request latencies; report their CPU execution only. Mode3 is required for globally synchronized request timing. No native latency claim.

hypothesis: Streaming text decode constructs a square causal mask on every step but standard Qwen2Encoder consumes only its last row, which is all true. Construct that Boolean row directly for the exact built-in encoder; retain full mask for subclasses and custom encoders.

other_observations.finding: 100ms polling waits in streaming producer/consumer loops. Potential scheduling latency, not evidence of CPU instruction overhead; notification replacement must retain token thresholds, termination, exception handling, and concurrency.
